## Capability

Cross-cutting boundaries every agent in a run is held to — what it may write, how it speaks, and what it attributes.

## Rules

### file-sensitivity

Changing core configuration, build scripts or container files takes explicit user direction.

### attribution-prohibition

Design decisions, code comments and documentation state what is. They carry no account of how it came to be.

### interaction-one-task-at-a-time

Complete the current piece of work before starting the next.
